brief: LLM routing in 2026 — 5 strategies that 10× throughput and halve costs.

slots.subtitle: These five routing strategies cut inference costs in half while pushing throughput to ten times baseline.

slots.title: Cascade from
slots.subtitle: Route every prompt through a cascading confidence ladder that only pays for frontier intelligence when necessary.
slots.pod1Body: Handle eighty percent of traffic for pennies per million tokens.
slots.pod2Body: Only promote complex prompts when confidence scores drop.
slots.pod3Body: Reserve frontier models for edge cases and critical reasoning.

slots.title: Cache answers
slots.subtitle: Store embeddings of every query to serve near-duplicate requests without ever calling the API again.
slots.pod1Body: Match new questions to cached vectors with cosine similarity above 0.95.
slots.pod2Body: Return answers from Redis or SQLite faster than a network hop.
slots.pod3Body: Cut token spend by half on repetitive support and coding questions.

slots.title: Balance load
slots.subtitle: Auto-failover between OpenAI and Anthropic to eliminate rate-limit downtime and optimize spend in real time.
slots.pod1Body: Trip the breaker when latency spikes or error rates exceed thresholds.
slots.pod2Body: Distribute requests evenly to stay under per-minute provider quotas.
slots.pod3Body: Route to the cheapest endpoint that meets accuracy thresholds.

slots.title: Compress prompts
slots.subtitle: Shrink retrieval chunks and chat history to slash input tokens without losing context or answer quality.
slots.pod1Body: Summarize retrieved chunks into bullets to cut input length in half.
slots.pod2Body: Truncate history intelligently instead of naive last-message cutoff.
slots.pod3Body: Force JSON mode to eliminate verbose explanations and parsing overhead.

slots.title: Draft with
slots.subtitle: Use an 8B parameter draft model to generate tokens at lightning speed for frontier verification.
slots.pod1Body: Let Llama-3.1-8B draft responses before the heavy model looks.
slots.pod2Body: GPT-4o checks spans and corrects only mismatched tokens.
slots.pod3Body: Achieve triple speedup without sacrificing output quality or safety.

slots.title: Build your
slots.subtitle: Abstract every provider behind a single OpenAI-compatible gateway with telemetry and auto-scaling inference.
slots.pod1Body: Present one endpoint that fans out to GPT-4, Claude, or Llama.
slots.pod2Body: Track spend per user, token latency, and error rates centrally.
slots.pod3Body: Spin up GPU workers only when queue depth exceeds thresholds.

slots.ctaBody: Stop burning budget on brute-force inference and route smarter with cascading, caching, and elastic scaling today.
